description: Export a doc OR page as pure, round-trippable Markdown. target='doc' renders the Tiptap body; target='page' renders the blocks with each component block serialized back to a `:::component{...}` directive. The text round-trips through content_import_markdown. (For the richer JSON export envelope — components inlined, settings, domains, audit — use content_export_doc / content_export_page instead.)

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_export_markdown
